description: DRAFT. NOT IN FORCE. The ski@v2 check blob of SPEC §3.2's draft registration. ski@v1's blob has no schema in this repository — it is constrained in code (validate_ski_blob) — so this file is new surface, not a copy. It is DERIVATIVE AND SECONDARY to SPEC.md and cannot express what matters most about a blob: that its bytes are JCS-canonical and that the file's name is their SHA-256. A validator that ran only this schema would accept blobs no verifier accepts.
